confidence_notes: FX came from one RBA search, which showed the 18 Nov 2026 rate of 0.6720 USD per AUD. Food and drink anchors came from three searches, which returned a Numbeo rankings snippet (inexpensive meal R$45, mid-range meal for two R$235) and crowdsourced aggregators (MyLifeElsewhere, Travel Tables). The aggregators disagree and some are dated. I converted BRL at roughly R$5.1-5.2 per USD, which is an assumption. Beer is about R$12-14 per serving at restaurants and cappuccino about R$11-12. Cocktail and wine-by-the-glass had no direct data, so they are set as multiples of the beer price (cocktail about 2.3x, wine glass about 2x). Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge, with no listings checked. They are the least certain, and prices vary a lot by season, since Florianópolis peaks in Dec-Feb and July is mostly low-to-mid season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Florianópolis is a pricier, tourism-driven southern Brazilian city, roughly 30% above the Brazilian average. I treated it as comparable to Porto Alegre or Curitiba with a beach-resort premium.
